The claim is restricted to the published strong stable branch.

value.rationale: The center of vorticity is a canonical observable of a collapsing point-vortex cluster. The result separates the common wall-induced drift from a shape-specific oscillatory second-order signal at a precise nonzero amplitude for an explicit profile. This resolves a natural quantitative question left at O(tau) by the motivating existence theorem, without relying on arbitrary parameter slicing, code novelty or generic claims about other solutions.
